0.name: TEXT_REGGYRRESISTANCEOFFICERSREPORT_00655_SYSTEM_000_001
0.description: This pile of papers appears to be a collection of reports written by members of the Resistance.

14.name: TEXT_REGGYRRESISTANCEOFFICERSREPORT_00655_REPORT00655_000_003
14.description: Name: Gaius Baelsar<hex:02100103>Pure-blooded Garlean and former legatus of the XIVth Legion. During his time in the Empire, he was credited with the conquest of five cities. Extremely dangerous, though currently aligned against Garlemald.

15.name: TEXT_REGGYRRESISTANCEOFFICERSREPORT_00655_REPORT00655_000_004
15.description: Assumed dead following the battle of Castrum Meridianum, he survived and made the elimination of Ascians his primary objective, operating under the name “Shadowhunter.”

16.name: TEXT_REGGYRRESISTANCEOFFICERSREPORT_00655_REPORT00655_000_005
16.description: The Ultima Weapon project he once helmed has since been taken over by the VIIth Legion, prompting him to cooperate with the Eorzean Alliance in preventing new Weapons from being developed and deployed.

17.name: TEXT_REGGYRRESISTANCEOFFICERSREPORT_00655_REPORT00655_000_006
17.description: He has provided invaluable information on the Ruby Weapon, though it has recently come to light that the pilot was an orphan once under his care. There is a possibility that he may betray us and return to the Empire, so he must be monitored closely.

18.name: TEXT_REGGYRRESISTANCEOFFICERSREPORT_00655_REPORT00655_100_006
18.description: Together with the Warrior of Light, he was instrumental in ending the menace of the Weapon project and freeing Werlyt from imperial rule.

19.name: TEXT_REGGYRRESISTANCEOFFICERSREPORT_00655_REPORT00655_200_006
19.description: He later agreed to assist the Revolutionaries in rebuilding the region, following the ideals espoused by the orphans he raised.

20.name: TEXT_REGGYRRESISTANCEOFFICERSREPORT_00655_REPORT00655_300_006
20.description: Though Gaius Baelsar was once classified as highly dangerous, we may now consider him to be a valuable ally, particularly in matters pertaining to our relationship with Werlyt.

21.name: TEXT_REGGYRRESISTANCEOFFICERSREPORT_00655_REPORT00655_000_007
21.description: Name: The Ruby Weapon<hex:02100103>Warmachina developed by the VIIth Imperial Legion as a successor to the Ultima Weapon.

22.name: TEXT_REGGYRRESISTANCEOFFICERSREPORT_00655_REPORT00655_000_008
22.description: Our sources indicate that, like the original, it is able to absorb the aether of primals, which may be the cause of the vastly different appearance and combat capabilities. It possesses extremely dense armor and flexible claw-like weapons.

23.name: TEXT_REGGYRRESISTANCEOFFICERSREPORT_00655_REPORT00655_100_008
23.description: The deployment of the Ruby Weapon marked the first known case of the synthetic auracite system being used outside of Garlean territory. The combat data of Nael van Darnus, former legatus of the VIIth Imperial Legion, was used to enhance the warmachina's combat capabilities.

24.name: TEXT_REGGYRRESISTANCEOFFICERSREPORT_00655_REPORT00655_000_009
24.description: Shortly after its deployment in the Ghimlyt Dark, a team led by the Warrior of Light intercepted it and rendered it inoperable. Garlond Ironworks are currently investigating the wreckage.

25.name: TEXT_REGGYRRESISTANCEOFFICERSREPORT_00655_REPORT00655_100_009
25.description: Shortly after its deployment in the Ghimlyt Dark, a team led by the Warrior of Light intercepted it and rendered it inoperable. Garlond Ironworks carried out a thorough investigation of the wreckage.

26.name: TEXT_REGGYRRESISTANCEOFFICERSREPORT_00655_REPORT00655_000_020
26.description: Name: The Sapphire Weapon<hex:02100103>Warmachina developed by the VIIth Imperial Legion as a successor to the Ultima Weapon.

27.name: TEXT_REGGYRRESISTANCEOFFICERSREPORT_00655_REPORT00655_000_021
27.description: The second known case of the synthetic auracite system being used in open combat, employing the combat data of Regula van Hydrus, former legatus of the VIth Imperial Legion.

28.name: TEXT_REGGYRRESISTANCEOFFICERSREPORT_00655_REPORT00655_000_022
28.description: Evidence indicates that the warmachina was in an incomplete state, and Oversoul was used to mitigate mechanical deficiencies.

29.name: TEXT_REGGYRRESISTANCEOFFICERSREPORT_00655_REPORT00655_000_023
29.description: It was deployed off the coast of Werlyt and sent into battle with Garlond Ironworks' G<hex:021F0103>Warrior, piloted by <hex:022903EB0203>. It was then rendered inoperable but structurally intact, with only superficial damage sustained.

30.name: TEXT_REGGYRRESISTANCEOFFICERSREPORT_00655_REPORT00655_000_040
30.description: Name: The Emerald Weapon<hex:02100103>Warmachina developed by the VIIth Imperial Legion as a successor to the Ultima Weapon.

31.name: TEXT_REGGYRRESISTANCEOFFICERSREPORT_00655_REPORT00655_000_041
31.description: The third reported instance of the synthetic auracite system being employed in battle. Combat data from Gaius van Baelsar, former legatus of the XIVth Imperial Legion was used as a basis for its attack parameters.

32.name: TEXT_REGGYRRESISTANCEOFFICERSREPORT_00655_REPORT00655_000_042
32.description: Our analysis concludes that any data collected after van Baelsar commenced his invasion of Eorzea was lost following his defeat at the Praetorium. Therefore, the data used in the Emerald Weapon must have been gathered in the days prior to the Seventh Umbral Calamity.

33.name: TEXT_REGGYRRESISTANCEOFFICERSREPORT_00655_REPORT00655_000_043
33.description: His gunblade techniques and tactics involving multiple soldiers bearing ranged weapons were incorporated in the warmachina's armaments, in particular, the floating manipulators that could be positioned at various locations around the battlefield.

34.name: TEXT_REGGYRRESISTANCEOFFICERSREPORT_00655_REPORT00655_000_044
34.description: The Emerald Weapon is believed to have been transported from the imperial base in Terncliff to Castrum Marinum, where it underwent final adjustments. It was then finally destroyed in an operation spearheaded by <hex:022903EB0203>.

35.name: TEXT_REGGYRRESISTANCEOFFICERSREPORT_00655_REPORT00655_000_080
35.description: Name: The Diamond Weapon<hex:02100103>Warmachina developed by the VIIth Imperial Legion as a successor to the Ultima Weapon.

36.name: TEXT_REGGYRRESISTANCEOFFICERSREPORT_00655_REPORT00655_000_081
36.description: Although it was the fourth reported instance of the synthetic auracite system being employed in battle, the Diamond Weapon differed from the previous models in that it did not incorporate the combat data of a renowned imperial soldier.

37.name: TEXT_REGGYRRESISTANCEOFFICERSREPORT_00655_REPORT00655_000_082
37.description: Instead, a living subject, the man known only as Alfonse, was fused with the core prior to activation.

38.name: TEXT_REGGYRRESISTANCEOFFICERSREPORT_00655_REPORT00655_000_083
38.description: The Diamond Weapon itself is believed to have gained the primal abilities possessed by the previous Weapons, though the exact process used is still under investigation.

39.name: TEXT_REGGYRRESISTANCEOFFICERSREPORT_00655_REPORT00655_000_084
39.description: In addition to the various armaments concealed within its outer casing, the Diamond Weapon also displayed combat capabilities similar to those of the Ruby and Emerald. By purging the bulk of its armor, it was able to further increase its maneuverability.

40.name: TEXT_REGGYRRESISTANCEOFFICERSREPORT_00655_REPORT00655_000_085
40.description: According to various sources, the Diamond Weapon's creator, Valens van Varro, had originally planned to overthrow the Garlean capital and seize the throne. Due to the actions of the Warrior of Light and <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468697303> comrades, this did not come to pass.

41.name: TEXT_REGGYRRESISTANCEOFFICERSREPORT_00655_REPORT00655_000_010
41.description: Name: Milisandia<hex:02100103>Pilot of the Ruby Weapon. All other information regarding the subject was gained via verbal testimony of Gaius Baelsar, and must therefore be considered as potentially unreliable.

42.name: TEXT_REGGYRRESISTANCEOFFICERSREPORT_00655_REPORT00655_000_011
42.description: Her parents were killed when their homeland in the imperial territory of Werlyt was struck by an epidemic. She was later taken into the care of Gaius, with several other orphans.

43.name: TEXT_REGGYRRESISTANCEOFFICERSREPORT_00655_REPORT00655_000_012
43.description: She was despondent and introverted at first, but through the guidance of Alfonse, the eldest of the orphans, she grew to become more assertive and self-assured.

44.name: TEXT_REGGYRRESISTANCEOFFICERSREPORT_00655_REPORT00655_000_013
44.description: Little is known of how she came to pilot the Ruby Weapon. According to Gaius, her emotional attachment to Alfonse may have been what compelled her to participate in this dangerous mission.

45.name: TEXT_REGGYRRESISTANCEOFFICERSREPORT_00655_REPORT00655_000_014
45.description: The report delivered by Cid Garlond following the preliminary examination of the Ruby Weapon's remains states that Milisandia's body was fused with its core, with no vital signs detected.<hex:02100103>Estimated age at time of death: 20 years old.

46.name: TEXT_REGGYRRESISTANCEOFFICERSREPORT_00655_REPORT00655_000_030
46.description: Name: Ricon<hex:02100103>Pilot of the Sapphire Weapon. All other information regarding the subject was gained via verbal testimony of Gaius Baelsar.

47.name: TEXT_REGGYRRESISTANCEOFFICERSREPORT_00655_REPORT00655_000_031
47.description: Born and raised in Werlyt until his parents died in an epidemic, after which he was taken into the care of Gaius in an imperial orphanage.

48.name: TEXT_REGGYRRESISTANCEOFFICERSREPORT_00655_REPORT00655_000_032
48.description: Though he lacked the physical prowess of his peers, his high degree of dexterity made him ideally suited to maintaining equipment and similar tasks.

49.name: TEXT_REGGYRRESISTANCEOFFICERSREPORT_00655_REPORT00655_000_033
49.description: Even after joining the military, he remained shy and withdrawn. However, on occasions where the safety of his friends was threatened, he would not hesitate to defend them.

50.name: TEXT_REGGYRRESISTANCEOFFICERSREPORT_00655_REPORT00655_000_034
50.description: He later replaced the designated pilot of the Sapphire Weapon, fellow orphan Rex, and was absorbed by the Weapon's core upon activating Oversoul.<hex:02100103>Estimated age at time of death: 17 years old.

51.name: TEXT_REGGYRRESISTANCEOFFICERSREPORT_00655_REPORT00655_000_050
51.description: Name: Rex<hex:02100103>Pilot of the Emerald Weapon. All other information regarding the subject was gained via verbal testimony of Gaius Baelsar.

52.name: TEXT_REGGYRRESISTANCEOFFICERSREPORT_00655_REPORT00655_000_051
52.description: This former civilian of Werlyt was orphaned at a young age when an epidemic killed his parents. He was later fostered by Gaius and was raised alongside several others in an imperial orphanage.

53.name: TEXT_REGGYRRESISTANCEOFFICERSREPORT_00655_REPORT00655_000_052
53.description: He was known for being extroverted and outgoing, and his lack of restraint often made him the center of attention.

54.name: TEXT_REGGYRRESISTANCEOFFICERSREPORT_00655_REPORT00655_000_053
54.description: However, this was accompanied by an explosive temper, and he would often confront those he believed were threatening his foster siblings, with little regard for rank or social status.

55.name: TEXT_REGGYRRESISTANCEOFFICERSREPORT_00655_REPORT00655_000_054
55.description: He later joined the Weapon project in order to support his foster brother Alfonse. His final mission was to pilot the Emerald Weapon, which ended with him becoming fused with its core and perishing shortly after.<hex:02100103>Estimated age at time of death: 18 years old.

56.name: TEXT_REGGYRRESISTANCEOFFICERSREPORT_00655_REPORT00655_000_060
56.description: Name: Alfonse<hex:02100103>The following regarding the subject was gained via verbal testimony of Gaius Baelsar.

57.name: TEXT_REGGYRRESISTANCEOFFICERSREPORT_00655_REPORT00655_000_061
57.description: A civilian of Werlyt whose parents died in an epidemic. He and several other children were later taken into the care of Gaius.

58.name: TEXT_REGGYRRESISTANCEOFFICERSREPORT_00655_REPORT00655_000_062
58.description: As the most senior of his group of orphans, he took his role as their older brother very seriously. His only known blood relative, his younger sister Allie, was among them.

59.name: TEXT_REGGYRRESISTANCEOFFICERSREPORT_00655_REPORT00655_000_063
59.description: Gaius had instilled in him the belief that all within the Empire must be treated fairly, regardless of race or background. Following his foster father's disappearance, Alfonse sought to protect the victims of prejudice, such as that faced by his compatriots.

60.name: TEXT_REGGYRRESISTANCEOFFICERSREPORT_00655_REPORT00655_000_064
60.description: In an attempt to prise Werlyt free from the Empire's grasp, he planned to claim the Diamond Weapon for himself. However, it was his sister Allie who was chosen as its pilot.

61.name: TEXT_REGGYRRESISTANCEOFFICERSREPORT_00655_REPORT00655_000_065
61.description: Alfonse was instead fused with the Weapon's core. The process was irreversible and he is considered to have perished.<hex:02100103>Estimated age at time of death: 21 years old.

62.name: TEXT_REGGYRRESISTANCEOFFICERSREPORT_00655_REPORT00655_000_070
62.description: Name: Allie<hex:02100103>Pilot of the Diamond Weapon. All other information regarding the subject was gained via verbal testimony of Gaius Baelsar.

63.name: TEXT_REGGYRRESISTANCEOFFICERSREPORT_00655_REPORT00655_000_071
63.description: Born in Werlyt and fostered by Gaius after her parents were killed in an epidemic.

64.name: TEXT_REGGYRRESISTANCEOFFICERSREPORT_00655_REPORT00655_000_072
64.description: Ever since first entering the orphanage, she was extremely withdrawn and averse to any sort of confrontation. She clung constantly to Alfonse, her older brother by birth.

65.name: TEXT_REGGYRRESISTANCEOFFICERSREPORT_00655_REPORT00655_000_073
65.description: When he and several other orphans attempted to win the freedom of their compatriots at the cost of their own lives, they did not include Allie in their plans. After learning the truth, she tried to rescue Alfonse by taking control of the Diamond Weapon.

66.name: TEXT_REGGYRRESISTANCEOFFICERSREPORT_00655_REPORT00655_000_074
66.description: Once she was inside the cockpit, she discovered that Alfonse had been fused with its core, and that he was beyond salvation. She has yet to recover from the trauma she suffered that day.

67.name: TEXT_REGGYRRESISTANCEOFFICERSREPORT_00655_REPORT00655_000_075
67.description: Allie is currently undergoing treatment in Terncliff at the orders of Gaius. She has been awarded the Medal of Independence by the new government of Werlyt.<hex:02100103>Age at time of incidents described: 16 years old.

68.name: TEXT_REGGYRRESISTANCEOFFICERSREPORT_00655_REPORT00655_000_090
68.description: Name: Valens van Varro<hex:02100103>Former legatus of the VIIth Imperial Legion. The following account was gained via verbal testimony of a magitek engineer held in custody.

69.name: TEXT_REGGYRRESISTANCEOFFICERSREPORT_00655_REPORT00655_000_091
69.description: A pure-blooded Garlean raised in the capital, Valens was trained as an engineer at the Magitek Academy. After graduation, he instead pursued a career in the military.

70.name: TEXT_REGGYRRESISTANCEOFFICERSREPORT_00655_REPORT00655_000_092
70.description: His insightful deployment of magitek weaponry and unflinching use of tactics deemed reprehensible by his peers brought him success on the battlefield, and he quickly moved through the ranks.

71.name: TEXT_REGGYRRESISTANCEOFFICERSREPORT_00655_REPORT00655_000_093
71.description: When the time came to select a new legatus for the XIVth Legion, Valens was rejected in favor of Gaius van Baelsar. A one-sided rivalry developed between the two, little to Gaius's knowledge.

72.name: TEXT_REGGYRRESISTANCEOFFICERSREPORT_00655_REPORT00655_000_094
72.description: Whatever Gaius sought to achieve, Valens would choose opposing methods as a matter of course. The notable exception to this was his desire to continue the Ultima Weapon project once helmed by Gaius, possibly in a bid to surpass his nemesis.

73.name: TEXT_REGGYRRESISTANCEOFFICERSREPORT_00655_REPORT00655_000_095
73.description: Though his level of technical expertise is without question, his eagerness to employ inhumane methods is viewed with contempt by even his fellow imperials. Having analyzed the Empire's data on the Heart of Sabik and similar artifacts, Valens developed the synthetic auracite system.

74.name: TEXT_REGGYRRESISTANCEOFFICERSREPORT_00655_REPORT00655_000_096
74.description: It was designed to fuse the pilot with the machine's core during battle in order to enhance its abilities, killing the subject in the process. The system was “perfected” with the completion of the Diamond Weapon, in which a living soldier was integrated with the core prior to activation.

75.name: TEXT_REGGYRRESISTANCEOFFICERSREPORT_00655_REPORT00655_000_097
75.description: Valens's plan to use this technology to seize the imperial throne was eventually undone by the selfsame pilots that he had selected to take part in the Weapon project, along with his archrival, Gaius.<hex:02100103>Age at time of death: 56 years old.
